newsitem.title: USA: Sioux Falls cattle off $1.00-2.00 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Sioux Falls cattle off $1.00-2.00 - USDA.

text.p: USDA said slaughter steers and heifers were $1.00 to $2.00 lower than late last week, trading was slow by mid-session.
Steers - part load choice predominantly 3 Black near 1350 lbs 68.50. High-select and choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs 66.50-67.50. Select and choice 2-3 1100-1300 lbs 62.50-66.50.
Heifers - high select and choice 2-3 1050-1200 lbs 65.50- 67.00. Select and choice 2-3 1000-1125 lbs 62.50-65.50. Select 1-2 60.50-62.50.
